arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Karlan argued the First Amendment bars retaliatory arrests.
She stated this applies even with probable cause.
Mr. Dvoretzky proposed four backstops for police officers.
He addressed hypotheticals about officers dealing with riots.
